description: Source code for Go unit tests verifying storage implementation parity in the internal storage package. Tests include creation, update, querying, workflow storage, and transaction rollback behaviors.

methods.name: TestStorageParity_CreateExecutionRecord
methods.description: Tests that CreateExecutionRecord behaves the same for local and postgres storage backends.

methods.name: TestStorageParity_UpdateExecutionRecord
methods.description: Tests that UpdateExecutionRecord maintains parity in behavior between storage implementations.

methods.name: TestStorageParity_QueryExecutionRecords
methods.description: Verifies query operations return consistent results across storage types.

methods.name: TestStorageParity_StoreWorkflowExecution
methods.description: Tests storing and retrieving a workflow execution, ensuring parity.

methods.name: TestStorageParity_TransactionRollback
methods.description: Ensures transaction rollback works correctly and data remains consistent after a failing update.
